rulings.restated: Enter the amount from ftc helper "Credit is the smaller of creditable foreign tax and regular income tax; zero if no foreign tax".
rulings.model: The helper uses f1040 line 16 alone as regular tax, but the IRS says regular tax is the total of Form 1040 line 16 and Schedule 2 (Form 1040), Part I, line 1z, less any tax included on line 16 from Form 4972.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope/representation on supported completed individual returns; i1116 (2025) pp.1–2 requires the smaller of foreign tax and regular tax, with p.25 Line20 defining regular tax as Form1040 line16 plus Schedule2 PartI line1z less Form4972 tax, with Form8978 adjustments. s2.other explicitly excludes advance-credit repayments and every other unsupported Schedule2 tax and is enforced at s2.line3/line21. scope.other_line16 excludes Forms4972/8978 and is enforced at f1040.line16. Thus the additional terms are zero on supported completed returns; Form1040 line16 is the regular-tax amount in this slice. Stand-alone excluded cases are not claimed equivalent. The reviewer correctly identifies the full IRS rule; its reduction here depends on those declared refusals, not model noise.
